# supplier-parent spend and mitigation workbook

Case: CASE-047
Document control number: SPEC-0047
Effective revision: R6
Superseded revision visible in archive: R10
Subject: sole-source spend exposure
Primary measure: open and forecast spend with the supplier
Source finished or header quantity: 13951
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 USD
Unit: USD
Eligibility definition: spend covered by approved mitigation actions
Exclusion definition: unmitigated concentration above policy threshold
Control: exposure must combine open POs, forecast, currency, and supplier parent
Task-specific financial control: unmitigated concentration escalation threshold
Control threshold: USD 250.0

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000047, organization SEA, and CASE-047. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from time before production exposure; external timing is conditional on alternate-source qualification timing. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
